modelAtelier.name: Clean Topology Humanoid · Quad-Loop Sculpt Base
modelAtelier.reference: Experimental UV-first T-pose humanoid. Quad-indexed contour rings define an ellipsoid head, torso, two arms, five digits per hand and two legs with curved feet. Original UV seam locations remain stable when sculpting vertices. Separate surface components at anatomical junctions are intentional; this is not a single welded manifold and is unrigged. Neutral checker diagnostic skin reveals stretching; replace it freely.
